scope: Source-only intake of the collector index/breadth and TAIEX history bundles; paper/research data. No deployment, hosted pull or hosted acceptance claim.

real_inputs.method: The real collector spiders (deploy/collector collector_stack CollectorRunner) run over committed unedited official TWSE responses via FixtureTransport; the resulting bundle tree is read by the production pull entry point execute_provider_owned_adapter -> CollectorBundleAdapter.

results.isolation: Index/breadth/OHLC records are excluded from persist_latest_market_snapshots by is_index_breadth_record (dataset and connector guard) and are stored under normalized/tw_index_daily and normalized/tw_market_breadth_daily only; no normalized/tw_price_daily is written.

design_notes: TAIEX history rows (collector dataset tw_index_ohlc_daily) are normalized into tw_index_daily with open/high/low; collector dataset kept as source_collector_dataset.
Index series key is the index name (series_id). MI_INDEX rows carry close, change_points and change_percent only; open/high/low are never filled.
Breadth keeps the source whole_market/stocks groups and adds flat catalogue fields (14).
available_time is first acquisition (fetch time), so backfilled 2012 rows are visible to read_feature_series only from their acquisition; nothing is dated earlier than known.
A connector can prove only one persona requirement, so the breadth dataset rides the index-breadth connector's requirement; the two index sources are separate requirements for tw_index_daily.
Missing index_name/close/trade_date or breadth counts raise SourceEvidenceError (fail closed).
